description: The most regal pair you did ever see! These Robins, available as King or Queen (sold individually), , offer a majestic and festive accent that embodies the spirit of the season. Whether gracing a tabletop, mantelpiece or serving as a focal point in a joyous display, they are a symbol of elegance & joy that enhances the magic & beauty of Christmas. Resin. Each bird comes boxed. Approx. size of each: H14 x W5.5 x D9cm.
